d.name: Dedenne

attacks.name: Entrainment
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Energy Short
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage times the amount of Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

d.name: Drowzee

attacks.name: Sinister Suggestion
attacks.text: Whenever your opponent flips a coin during his or her next turn, treat it as tails.

d.flavorText: Puts enemies to sleep, then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating only bad dreams.

d.name: Hypno

attacks.name: Hand Control
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals his or her hand. You may choose a Supporter card you find there. If you do, your opponent plays that Supporter card. However, you make all decisions for that card. (That Supporter card is discarded.)

attacks.name: Hypnoblast
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

d.flavorText: It carries a pendulum-like device. There once was an incident in which it took away a child it hypnotized.

d.name: Jynx

abilities.name: Victory Kiss
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may heal 10 damage from your Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hug
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

d.flavorText: It wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.

d.name: Skorupi

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

d.flavorText: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.

d.name: Gothita

attacks.name: Psy Bolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

d.flavorText: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

d.name: Gothorita

attacks.name: Fortunate Eye
attacks.text: Look at the top 5 cards of your opponent's deck and put them back on top of his or her deck in any order.

d.flavorText: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.

d.name: Gothitelle

abilities.name: Teleport Room
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard any Stadium card in play. If you do, put a Stadium card with a different name from your discard pile into play.

attacks.name: Psy Report
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals his or her hand.

d.flavorText: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

d.name: Golett

attacks.name: Rock Smash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

d.flavorText: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.

d.name: Golurk

attacks.name: Wreck
attacks.text: If there is any Stadium card in play, this attack does 60 more damage. Discard that Stadium card.

d.flavorText: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.

d.name: Machop
d.flavorText: It hefts a Graveler repeatedly to strengthen its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.

d.name: Machoke
d.flavorText: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

d.name: Machamp

abilities.name: Fighting Fury
abilities.text: Each of your Fighting Pokémon's attacks do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Machamp Crush
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done by attacks from the Defending Pokémon is reduced by 40 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

d.flavorText: Its four ruggedly developed arms can launch a flurry of 1,000 punches in just two seconds.

d.name: Hitmonlee

attacks.name: Stretch Kick
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

d.name: Hitmonchan

attacks.name: Bullet Punch
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.

d.name: Hitmontop

attacks.name: Quick Draw
attacks.text: Draw a card.

attacks.name: Helicoptero
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It fights while spinning like a top. The centrifugal force boosts its destructive power by 10.

d.name: Breloom

attacks.name: Giga Drain
attacks.text: Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sky Uppercut
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

d.flavorText: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

d.name: Makuhita
d.flavorText: It toughens up by slamming into thick trees over and over. It gains a sturdy body and dauntless spirit.

d.name: Hariyama

abilities.name: Thick Fat
abilities.text: Any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Fire or Water Pokémon is reduced by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

d.flavorText: It stomps on the ground to build power. It can send a 10-ton truck flying with a straight-arm punch.

d.name: Trapinch

attacks.name: Mountain Munch
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

d.flavorText: It lives in arid deserts. It makes a sloping pit trap in sand where it patiently awaits prey.

d.name: Lucario-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Missile Jab
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

attacks.name: Corkscrew Smash
attacks.text: You may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

d.name: M Lucario-EX
rules: Mega Evolution rule: When 1 of your Pokémon becomes a Mega Evolution Pokémon, your turn ends.
Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Rising Fist
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.name: M Lucario-EX
rules: Mega Evolution rule: When 1 of your Pokémon becomes a Mega Evolution Pokémon, your turn ends.
Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Rising Fist
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.name: Mienfoo

attacks.name: Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

d.flavorText: It takes pride in the speed at which it can use moves. What it loses in power, it makes up for in quantity.

d.name: Mienshao

attacks.name: Aero Turn
attacks.text: Return this Pokémon and all cards attached to it to your hand.

d.flavorText: It wields the fur on its arm like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

d.name: Landorus

attacks.name: Shout of Power
attacks.text: Attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as "The Guardian of the Fields."

d.name: Pancham

attacks.name: Bad-Influence Evolution
attacks.text: If you have any Darkness Pokémon on your Bench, search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon. (This counts as evolving this Pokémon.) Shuffle your deck afterward.

d.flavorText: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.

d.name: Pancham

attacks.name: Comet Punch
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

d.flavorText: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.

d.name: Tyrunt
rules: Put this card onto your Bench only with the effect of Jaw Fossil

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn't like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.

d.name: Tyrantrum

attacks.name: Chew Up
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has any Special Energy attached to it, this attack does 90 more damage.

attacks.name: Giga Impact
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

d.flavorText: Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.

d.name: Hawlucha

abilities.name: Shining Spirit
abilities.text: Damage from this Pokémon's attacks isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

attacks.name: Flying Press
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon isn't a Pokémon-EX, this attack does nothing.

d.flavorText: Although its body is small, its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.

d.name: Hawlucha-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Counterattack
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), put 2 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

attacks.name: Moonsault Stomp
attacks.text: If there is any Stadium card in play, this attack does 40 more damage.

d.name: Drapion

attacks.name: Venoshock
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 40 more damage.

attacks.name: Venomous Fang
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

d.flavorText: It takes great pride in its strength. Even though it can tear foes apart, it finishes them off with powerful poison.

d.name: Scraggy
d.flavorText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling it skin up to its neck.

d.name: Scrafty

attacks.name: Machine Gun Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads. This Pokémon is now Confused.

d.flavorText: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.

d.name: Pangoro

attacks.name: Clobber
attacks.text: You may discard an Item card from your hand. If you do, this attack does 40 more damage.

attacks.name: Hammer Arm
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

d.flavorText: Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won't put up with bullying. It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies.

d.name: Clefairy

attacks.name: Moonlight
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

d.name: Clefairy

attacks.name: Moonblast
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done by attacks from the Defending Pokémon is reduced by 10 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

d.flavorText: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

d.name: Clefable

attacks.name: Follow Me
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Moonblast
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done by attacks from the Defending Pokémon is reduced by 30 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

d.flavorText: Its hearing is so acute it can hear a pin drop over half a mile away. It lives on quiet mountains.

d.name: Sylveon

attacks.name: Curly Ribbon
attacks.text: Move an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon to 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Echoed Voice
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Echoed Voice attack does 50 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

d.flavorText: It sends a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm fights.

d.name: Klefki

abilities.name: Secret Key
abilities.text: Each of your Fairy Pokémon's Resistance is now -40.

attacks.name: Fairy Lock
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

d.flavorText: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.

d.name: Dragonite-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Bust In
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench, you may move any number of basic Energy attached to your Pokémon to this Pokémon. If you do, switch this Pokémon with your Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Jet Sonic
attacks.text: You may discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 40 more damage.

d.name: Vibrava

attacks.name: Charge Energy
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

d.flavorText: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.

d.name: Flygon

attacks.name: Rainbow Shower
attacks.text: Attach as many basic Energy cards as you like from your hand to your Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Sand Sweep
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from each of your Pokémon that has any Energy attached to it.

d.flavorText: It hides itself by kicking up desert sand with its wings. Red covers shield its eyes from sand.

d.name: Noivern

abilities.name: Echolocation
abilities.text: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.

attacks.name: Boomburst
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.

d.name: Lickitung

attacks.name: Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

d.flavorText: Its long tongue, slathered with a gooey saliva, sticks to anything, so it is very useful.

d.name: Lickilicky

attacks.name: Knock Off
attacks.text: Discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Lickichop
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.

d.name: Eevee

abilities.name: Energy Evolution
abilities.text: When you attach a basic Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon, you may search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon that is the same type as that Energy card and put it onto this Pokémon. (This counts as evolving this Pokémon.) Shuffle your deck afterward.

d.flavorText: A rare Pokémon that adapts to harsh environments by taking on different evolutionary forms.

d.name: Slakoth

attacks.name: Big Yawn
attacks.text: Both Active Pokémon are now Asleep.

d.flavorText: The way Slakoth lolls around makes anyone who watches it feel like doing the same.

d.name: Vigoroth

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: Its heartbeat is fast and its blood so agitated that it can't sit still for one second.

d.name: Slaking

attacks.name: Amnesia
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Knuckle Sandwich
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: The world's laziest Pokémon. It moves to another spot when there's no food left within its reach.

d.name: Patrat

attacks.name: Safety Check
attacks.text: Look at 1 of your face-down Prize cards.

d.flavorText: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

d.name: Watchog

attacks.name: Held-Item Inspection
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals his or her hand. Choose an Item card you find there. Your opponent shuffles that card into his or her deck.

attacks.name: Thorough Crunch
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, discard an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

d.name: Tornadus

attacks.name: Push Down
attacks.text: You may have your opponent switch his or her Active Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Twister Throw
attacks.text: If you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, this attack does 60 more damage.

d.flavorText: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

d.name: Noibat
d.flavorText: They live in pitch black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.

d.name: Battle Reporter
rules: Draw cards until you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Energy Switch
rules: Move a basic Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Fighting Stadium
rules: The attacks of each Fighting Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) do 20 more damage to the Defending Pokémon-EX (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

d.name: Focus Sash
rules: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.

If the Fighting Pokémon this card is attached to has full HP and would be Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack, that Pokémon is not Knocked Out and its remaining HP becomes 10 instead. Then, discard this card.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Fossil Researcher
rules: Search your deck for up to 2 in any combination of Amaura or Tyrunt and put them onto your bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Full Heal
rules: Remove all Special Conditions from your Active Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Jaw Fossil
rules: Look at the bottom 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Tyrunt you find there and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Korrina
rules: Search your deck for a Fighting Pokémon and an Item card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Maintenance
rules: Shuffle 2 cards from your hand into your deck. (If you can't shuffle 2 cards into your deck, you can't play this card.) Then, draw a card.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Mountain Ring
rules: Prevent all damage done to Benched Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).
This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

d.name: Sail Fossil
rules: Look at the bottom 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal an Amaura you find there and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Sparkling Robe
rules: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.
The Pokémon this card is attached to can't be affected by any Special Conditions. (Remove any Special Conditions affecting that Pokémon.)
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Super Scoop Up
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, put 1 of your Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your hand.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Tool Retriever
rules: Choose up to 2 Pokémon Tool cards attached to your Pokémon and put them into your hand.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Training Center
rules: Each Stage 1 and Stage 2 Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) gets +30 HP.
This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

d.name: Herbal Energy
rules: This card can only be attached to Grass Pokémon. This card provides Grass Energy only while this card is attached to a Grass Pokémon.
When you attach this card from your hand to 1 of your Grass Pokémon, heal 30 damage from that Pokémon.
(If this card is attached to anything other than a Grass Pokémon, discard this card.)

d.name: Strong Energy
rules: This card can only be attached to Fighting Pokémon. This card provides Fighting Energy only while this card is attached to a Fighting Pokémon.
The attacks of the Fighting Pokémon this card is attached to do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
(If this card is attached to anything other than a Fighting Pokémon, discard this card.)

d.name: Heracross-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Giga Power
attacks.text: You may do 40 more damage. If you do, this Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

d.name: Seismitoad-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Quaking Punch
attacks.text: Your opponent can't play any Item cards from his or her hand during his or her next turn.

attacks.name: Grenade Hammer
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 2 of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.name: Lucario-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Missile Jab
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

attacks.name: Corkscrew Smash
attacks.text: You may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

d.name: Dragonite-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Bust In
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench, you may move any number of basic Energy attached to your Pokémon to this Pokémon. If you do, switch this Pokémon with your Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Jet Sonic
attacks.text: You may discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 40 more damage.

d.name: Battle Reporter
rules: Draw cards until you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Fossil Researcher
rules: Search your deck for up to 2 in any combination of Amaura or Tyrunt and put them onto your bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Korrina
rules: Search your deck for a Fighting Pokémon and an Item card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: M Heracross-EX
rules: Mega Evolution rule: When 1 of your Pokémon becomes a Mega Evolution Pokémon, your turn ends.
Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Big Bang Horn
attacks.text: This attack does 180 damage minus 10 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

d.name: M Lucario-EX
rules: Mega Evolution rule: When 1 of your Pokémon becomes a Mega Evolution Pokémon, your turn ends.
Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Rising Fist
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.name: Venonat

attacks.name: Stun Spore
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

d.flavorText: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.

d.name: Venomoth

attacks.name: Dizzying Wind
attacks.text: Whenever your opponent plays a Trainer card from his or her hand during his or her next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that card has no effect. (Your opponent still discards that card.)

attacks.name: Noxious Scales
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused and Poisoned.

d.flavorText: The scales it scatters will paralyze anyone who touches them, making that person unable to stand.

d.name: Yanma

attacks.name: Air Slash
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Its eyes can see 360 degrees without moving its head. It won't miss prey—even those behind it.

d.name: Yanmega

attacks.name: Windfall
attacks.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 6 cards.

attacks.name: Surprise Strike
attacks.text: If this Pokémon was on the Bench and became your Active Pokémon this turn, this attack does 50 more damage.

d.flavorText: It prefers to battle by biting apart foes' heads instantly while flying by at high speed.

d.name: Sewaddle

attacks.name: Nap
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

d.name: Swadloon

attacks.name: Protect
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

d.flavorText: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

d.name: Leavanny

attacks.name: Coordinate
attacks.text: Choose up to 2 of your Benched Pokémon that have no Pokémon Tools attached to them. For each of those Pokémon, search your deck for a Pokémon Tool card, and attach it to that Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Leaf Storm
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from each of your Grass Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.

d.name: Karrablast
d.flavorText: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

d.name: Fletchinder
d.flavorText: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.

d.name: Talonflame

attacks.name: Acrobatics
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Jet Shoot
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks is increased by 40 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

d.flavorText: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.

d.name: Litleo

attacks.name: Roar
attacks.text: Your opponent switches his or her Active Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.

d.name: Pyroar

abilities.name: Flare Command
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard a Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon. If you do, switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with his or her Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Inferno Onrush
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 30 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.

d.name: Krabby
d.flavorText: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.

d.name: Kingler

attacks.name: Guard Claw
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

d.flavorText: The large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.

d.name: Totodile

attacks.name: Fury Strikes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

d.flavorText: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

d.name: Croconaw

attacks.name: Crunch

attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage times the number of Pokémon in your discard pile that have the Night March attack.

d.name: Boldore

attacks.name: Gooey
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.text: If you don't have exactly 7 cards in your hand, this attack does nothing.

d.flavorText: It is said to deliver happiness. Being compassionate, it shares its egg with injured people.

d.name: Blissey

attacks.name: Tender Vengeance

attacks.name: Charge Dash

d.flavorText: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.

d.name: Girafarig

attacks.name: Psybite

d.flavorText: While it sleeps, the head of its tail keeps watch. The tail doesn't need to sleep.

d.name: Whismur

attacks.name: Screaming Fit

d.name: Loudred

attacks.name: Energy Press

d.name: Exploud

attacks.name: Boomburst
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.

d.name: Regigigas

attacks.name: Daunt

d.flavorText: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.

d.name: Bunnelby

d.name: Diggersby

attacks.name: Smithereen Smash

attacks.name: Earthquake

d.name: Fletchling

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

d.flavorText: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.

d.name: Furfrou

attacks.name: Tight Jaw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

d.flavorText: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.

d.flavorText: When it finds a flower it likes, it dwells on that flower its whole life long. It floats in the wind's embrace with an untroubled heart.

d.flavorText: Its scent is so overpowering that, unless a Trainer happens to really enjoy the smell, he or she will have a hard time walking alongside it.

d.flavorText: When the horns on its head shine in seven different colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

d.name: Axew
d.flavorText: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly.

d.name: Fraxure

d.flavorText: A broken tusk will not grow back, so it diligently sharpens its tusks on river rocks after the end of a battle.

d.name: Haxorus

d.flavorText: Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams. These Pokémon are covered in hard armor.

d.name: Noivern

attacks.name: Air Slash
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: The ultrasonic waves it emits from its ears can reduce a large boulder to pebbles. It emerges out of the dark to attack.

d.name: Meowth

d.flavorText: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

d.name: Doduo

attacks.name: Simultaneous Peck
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If either of them is tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Doduo Delivery
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

d.flavorText: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

d.name: Doduo

attacks.name: Doduo Delivery
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

d.flavorText: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

attacks.name: Fury Attack
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.

d.flavorText: An odd species that is rarely found. The three heads respectively represent joy, sadness, and anger.

d.name: Snorlax

abilities.name: Plump Body
abilities.text: Any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Knock Away
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

d.flavorText: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

d.name: Hoothoot

attacks.name: Proclaim the Night

d.flavorText: It always stand on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

d.name: Noctowl

attacks.name: High Flight
attacks.text: Each player reveals his or her hand. This attack does 20 damage times the number of Item cards revealed.

d.flavorText: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.

d.name: Teddiursa
d.flavorText: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

d.name: Ursaring

attacks.name: Drag Off
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with his or her Active Pokémon. This attack does 50 damage to the new Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Swing Around
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 more damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: Although it has a large body, it is quite skilled at climbing trees. It eats and sleeps in the treetops.

d.name: Smeargle

abilities.name: Second Coat
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may switch a basic Energy card attached to your Active Pokémon with a different type of basic Energy card from your discard pile.

d.flavorText: Once it becomes an adult, it has a tendency to let its comrades plant footprints on its back.

d.name: Swablu

attacks.name: Bind Wound
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

d.name: Starly

attacks.name: Call for Pals
attacks.text: Search your deck for as many Starly as you like and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

d.flavorText: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

d.name: Staravia

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

d.flavorText: It lives in forests and fields. Squabbles over territory occur when flocks collide.

d.name: Staraptor

attacks.name: Cyclone Slash
attacks.text: Before doing damage, have your opponent switch his or her Active Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Brave Bird
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

d.name: Chatot

attacks.name: Sing
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Aerial Ace
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

d.flavorText: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

d.name: Rufflet
d.flavorText: They will challenge anything, even strong opponents, without fear. Their frequent fights help them become stronger.

d.name: Braviary

attacks.name: Dual Cut
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 80 damage times the number of heads.

d.flavorText: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.

d.name: Noibat

attacks.name: Blot
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Even a robust wrestler will become dizzy and unable to stand when exposed to its 200,000-hertz ultrasonic waves.

d.flavorText: Even a robust wrestler will become dizzy and unable to stand when exposed to its 200,000-hertz ultrasonic waves.

d.name: Lotad

d.name: Torchic

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard a Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

d.name: Staryu

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

d.flavorText: It appears in large numbers by seashores. At night, its central core flashes with a red light.

d.name: Mudkip

d.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Tail Whip
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

d.flavorText: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

d.name: Electrike

attacks.name: Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Lightning Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

d.flavorText: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

d.name: Rhyhorn

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: It is inept at turning because of its four short legs. It can only charge and run in one direction.

d.name: Meditite
d.flavorText: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

d.name: Marill
d.flavorText: The tip of its tail is filled with oil that is lighter than water, so it acts as a float.

d.name: Zigzagoon

attacks.name: Sand Attack
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

d.flavorText: A Pokémon with abundant curiosity. It shows an interest in everything, so it always zigzags.

d.name: Skitty

attacks.name: Charm
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done by attacks from the Defending Pokémon is reduced by 20 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

d.flavorText: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

d.name: Chikorita

attacks.name: Blot
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.

d.name: Bayleef

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

d.flavorText: The buds that ring its neck give off a spicy aroma that perks people up.

d.name: Meganium

abilities.name: Overgrow
abilities.text: If this Pokémon's remaining HP is 50 or less, its attacks do 70 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Green Force
attacks.text: Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Meganium's breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

d.name: Seedot
d.flavorText: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

d.name: Kricketot

attacks.name: Bug Hunch
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Grass Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

d.flavorText: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.

d.name: Kricketune

attacks.name: Screech

d.flavorText: It signals its emotions with its melodies. Scientists are studying these melodic patterns.

d.name: Petilil

attacks.name: Aromatherapy
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from each of your Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Since they prefer moist, nutrient-rich soil, the areas where Petilil live are known to be good for growing plants.

d.name: Lilligant

attacks.name: Boo-Hoo

attacks.name: Leaf Slice
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

d.flavorText: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.

d.name: Durant

attacks.name: Mountain Munch
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Scrape Down
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any damage counters on it, discard the top 4 cards of your opponent's deck.

d.flavorText: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.

d.name: Growlithe
d.flavorText: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

d.name: Arcanine

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Its magnificent bark conveys a sense of majesty. Anyone hearing it can't help but grovel before it.

d.name: Numel
d.flavorText: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.

d.name: Camerupt

attacks.name: Eruption
attacks.text: Each player discards the top card of his or her deck. This attack does 60 more damage for each Energy card discarded in this way.

d.flavorText: If angered, the humps on its back erupt in a shower of molten lava. It lives in the craters of volcanoes.

d.name: Heatmor

attacks.name: Reinforced Flame
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, this attack does 20 more damage.

d.flavorText: It draws in air through its tail, transforms it into fire, and uses it like a tongue. It melts Durant and eats them.

d.name: Psyduck
d.flavorText: It has mystical powers but doesn't recall that it has used them. That is why it always looks puzzled.

d.name: Golduck

attacks.name: Derail
attacks.text: Discard a Special Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: The forelegs are webbed, helping to make it an adept swimmer. It can be seen swimming elegantly in lakes, etc.

d.flavorText: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won't even notice for a whole day.

d.name: Slowbro

d.flavorText: When its head was bitten, toxins entered Slowpoke's head and unlocked an extraordinary power.

d.flavorText: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be shattered, even with a bomb. The shell opens only when it is attacking.

attacks.text: Heal 60 damage from this Pokémon.

d.name: Pidgeot-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Mirror Move
attacks.text: If this Pokémon was damaged by an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does the same amount of damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Feather Lance
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.name: M Pidgeot-EX
rules: Mega Evolution rule: When 1 of your Pokémon becomes a Mega Evolution Pokémon, your turn ends.
Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Mach Cyclone
attacks.text: You may have your opponent switch his or her Active Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

d.name: Dragonite-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Pull Up
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench, you may put 2 Basic Pokémon (except for Dragonite-EX) from your discard pile into your hand.

attacks.name: Hyper Beam
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.name: Brock's Grit
rules: Shuffle 6 in any combination of Pokémon and basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: Misty's Determination
rules: Discard a card from your hand. If you do, look at the top 8 cards of your deck and put 1 of them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

d.name: ナッシー[Exeggutor]

attacks.name: ふみつけ[Stomp]
attacks.text: コインを1回投げオモテなら、10ダメージを追加。 Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

d.flavorText: Dr.オーヤマ考案「日米交流カード」パーティ気分で和洋せっちゅう。

d.name: Flying Pikachu

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Fly
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

d.flavorText: By learning how to fly, Pikachu overcame its weakness to Fighting Pokémon.

d.name: Surfing Pikachu
d.flavorText: One summer, a group of Pikachu was found riding the waves at the local beach.

d.name: Imakuni?'s Doduo
rules: (This card cannot be used at official tournaments.)

abilities.name: Frenzied Escape
abilities.text: When this Doduo retreats, hold this card and throw it as hard as you can because Doduo is running away. Throw the card horizontally with a snap to get the farthest distance!

attacks.name: Harmonize
attacks.text: From the moment you use this attack, you must begin to sing a song. (While the song is being sung, the game continues.) When the song is finished, this attack does 30 damage.

d.name: Here Comes Team Rocket!
rules: Each player turns all of his or her Prize cards face up. (Those Prize cards remain face up for the rest of the game.)
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).
